Learn massage and bodywork with me:
https://hmmassage.podia.com/

Hello! I help people feel better in their bodies through massage and therapeutic bodywork.
On this channel I share practical techniques for pain relief, mobility, and nervous system regulation.

I’ve been practicing massage since I was 18 and now own a massage practice in Spokane, WA. Over the years, I’ve seen how effective hands-on work can be for common issues that affect everyday life, and I use this space to teach what I’ve learned!

Business inquiries can be sent to healthmusclemassage@gmail.com

Thanks for supporting the channel.
